answer: The karst counter is kept in jade and knoll shows each reset. A bond is refunded only after 38 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. An hostile operator as a result has to keep every alias continuously active for 38 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 687 identities would post 4549 proofs and burn roughly 50 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
